_comment: CF-D9 cross-runtime eval fixture — the conditional-formatting matches?/2 contract. Each row: op + value(s) form a rule's `when`; `cell` is the RAW cell map (null = no cell / blank); `expect` is whether CondFormat.matches?(when, cell) fires. ExUnit asserts this now (cond_format_test.exs); the later sp-cf-surfaces JS grid renderer re-asserts this SAME file verbatim. Covers every op x value-class (number/text/boolean/blank/error), including must-NOT-match rows (cross-type eq, contains on blank, gt on text, reversed between endpoints, error cells with t=e and with a bare #N/A v).

rows.desc: gt: number cell above threshold matches
gt: number cell below threshold no match
gt: equal is strict, no match
gt: negative float above negative threshold matches
gt on text cell never matches
gt on boolean cell never matches
gt on blank (null) cell never matches
gt on blank (empty-string) cell never matches
gt on error cell (t=e) never matches
gt on error cell (bare #N/A v, no t) never matches

lt: number cell above threshold no match
lt: equal is strict, no match

lt on blank (null) never matches
